 **门禁边界（硬约束）**

+  （`Arc<dyn GhCli>` 要能进 `AppState`），原生 `async fn` in trait 不满足 dyn，故用 `async-trait`

+  **不用 `std::process`** —— 同步跑会阻塞 UI，与下一条「调用走 async」冲突。

+### 装配点（守住「删掉 cli.rs 仍能编译」这条线）
+
+`commands` 只认 `Arc<dyn GhCli>`，**不出现 `RealGh`**。装配在 `lib.rs`：构造 `RealGh` 后塞进 `AppState` 的
+`gh: Arc<dyn GhCli>` 字段。这样 `cli.rs` 的增删只波及 `lib.rs`，`domain` 与 `commands` 照旧编译。
+反之，若 `commands` 里出现 `use crate::gh::cli::RealGh`，上面那条硬线就名存实亡。
+
+### 探测的可测性（否则「假 gh 进 PATH」这条验收写不成稳定单测）
+
+`RealGh` 的**探测根**（PATH + 三条固定路径）与可执行名必须是构造参数，默认值才从环境取：
+
+```rust
+RealGh::new()               // 生产：PATH + %ProgramFiles% + %LOCALAPPDATA% + scoop shims
+RealGh::with_roots(roots)   // 测试：tempdir 里放 stub，不碰真实环境
+```
+
+两个原因：改进程级 `PATH` 是全局副作用，测试之间互相污染；Windows 原生 `cargo test` 没有 sh 解释器，
+所以 stub 必须是 `.cmd`（`cmd.exe` 可直接执行），不是 `.sh`。
+

+//! gh adapter：唯一与进程、argv、超时和原始输出打交道的地方。
+
+use std::ffi::OsString;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+use std::process::Stdio;
+use std::time::Duration;
+
+use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt;
+use tokio::process::Command;
+
+use super::model::{GhCli, GhError, GhStatus};
+
+const VERSION_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
+const AUTH_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
+
+pub struct RealGh {
+    roots: Vec<PathBuf>,
+    exe: OsString,
+}
+
+impl RealGh {
+    pub fn new() -> Self {
+        Self::with_roots_and_exe(production_roots(), default_exe_name())
+    }
+
+    pub fn with_roots(roots: Vec<PathBuf>) -> Self {
+        Self::with_roots_and_exe(roots, default_exe_name())
+    }
+
+    pub fn with_roots_and_exe(roots: Vec<PathBuf>, exe: impl Into<OsString>) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            roots,
+            exe: exe.into(),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn find(&self) -> Option<PathBuf> {
+        self.roots
+            .iter()
+            .map(|root| root.join(&self.exe))
+            .find(|candidate| candidate.is_file())
+    }
+
+    async fn run(
+        &self,
+        path: &Path,
+        args: &[&str],
+        limit: Duration,
+    ) -> Result<RunOutput, GhError> {
+        let mut command = Command::new(path);
+        command
+            .args(args)
+            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
+            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
+            .kill_on_drop(true);
+
+        let mut child = command.spawn().map_err(|e| GhError::CliFailed {
+            stderr: e.to_string(),
+        })?;
+        let mut stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or_else(|| GhError::CliFailed {
+            stderr: "stdout pipe unavailable".to_string(),
+        })?;
+        let mut stderr = child.stderr.take().ok_or_else(|| GhError::CliFailed {
+            stderr: "stderr pipe unavailable".to_string(),
+        })?;
+
+        let stdout_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
+            let mut buf = Vec::new();
+            stdout.read_to_end(&mut buf).await.map(|_| buf)
+        });
+        let stderr_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
+            let mut buf = Vec::new();
+            stderr.read_to_end(&mut buf).await.map(|_| buf)
+        });
+
+        let status = match tokio::time::timeout(limit, child.wait()).await {
+            Ok(Ok(status)) => status,
+            Ok(Err(e)) => {
+                let _ = child.kill().await;
+                let _ = child.wait().await;
+                stdout_task.abort();
+                stderr_task.abort();
+                return Err(GhError::CliFailed {
+                    stderr: e.to_string(),
+                });
+            }
+            Err(_) => {
+                tracing::warn!(
+                    target: "sincearc::gh",
+                    timeout_secs = limit.as_secs(),
+                    "gh command timed out"
+                );
+                let _ = child.kill().await;
+                let _ = child.wait().await;
+                stdout_task.abort();
+                stderr_task.abort();
+                return Err(GhError::Timeout);
+            }
+        };
+
+        let stdout = read_task(stdout_task).await?;
+        let stderr = read_task(stderr_task).await?;
+        Ok(RunOutput {
+            status,
+            stdout,
+            stderr,
+        })
+    }
+}
+
+impl Default for RealGh {
+    fn default() -> Self {
+        Self::new()
+    }
+}
+
+struct RunOutput {
+    status: std::process::ExitStatus,
+    stdout: String,
+    stderr: String,
+}
+
+async fn read_task(
+    task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<std::io::Result<Vec<u8>>>,
+) -> Result<String, GhError> {
+    let bytes = task
+        .await
+        .map_err(|e| GhError::CliFailed {
+            stderr: e.to_string(),
+        })?
+        .map_err(|e| GhError::CliFailed {
+            stderr: e.to_string(),
+        })?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes).into_owned())
+}
+
+fn parse_version(stdout: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    let first = stdout.lines().next()?.trim().trim_start_matches('\u{feff}');
+    let rest = first.strip_prefix("gh version ")?;
+    let version = rest.split_whitespace().next()?;
+    let core = version.split(|c: char| c == '-' || c == '+').next()?;
+    let parts: Vec<&str> = core.split('.').collect();
+    let numeric = parts
+        .iter()
+        .all(|part| !part.is_empty() && part.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()));
+    if parts.len() == 3 && numeric {
+        Some(version.to_string())
+    } else {
+        None
+    }
+}
+
+#[async_trait::async_trait]
+impl GhCli for RealGh {
+    async fn status(&self) -> Result<GhStatus, GhError> {
+        let Some(path) = self.find() else {
+            return Err(GhError::NotInstalled);
+        };
+        let gh_path = Some(path.display().to_string());
+
+        let version_output = self.run(&path, &["--version"], VERSION_TIMEOUT).await?;
+        if !version_output.status.success() {
+            tracing::warn!(
+                target: "sincearc::gh",
+                path = %path.display(),
+                status = %version_output.status,
+                stdout = %version_output.stdout,
+                stderr = %version_output.stderr,
+                "gh --version failed"
+            );
+            return Ok(GhStatus {
+                available: false,
+                version: None,
+                logged_in: false,
+                gh_path,
+            });
+        }
+        let Some(version) = parse_version(&version_output.stdout) else {
+            tracing::warn!(
+                target: "sincearc::gh",
+                path = %path.display(),
+                stdout = %version_output.stdout,
+                stderr = %version_output.stderr,
+                "could not parse gh version output"
+            );
+            return Ok(GhStatus {
+                available: false,
+                version: None,
+                logged_in: false,
+                gh_path,
+            });
+        };
+
+        let auth_output = self
+            .run(&path, &["auth", "status"], AUTH_TIMEOUT)
+            .await?;
+        let logged_in = auth_output.status.success();
+        if !logged_in {
+            tracing::debug!(
+                target: "sincearc::gh",
+                stderr = %auth_output.stderr,
+                "gh auth status reported a non-zero exit"
+            );
+        }
+
+        Ok(GhStatus {
+            available: true,
+            version: Some(version),
+            logged_in,
+            gh_path,
+        })
+    }
+}
+
+fn default_exe_name() -> OsString {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    {
+        OsString::from("gh.exe")
+    }
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    {
+        OsString::from("gh")
+    }
+}
+
+fn production_roots() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
+    let mut roots = Vec::new();
+    if let Ok(path) = std::env::var("PATH") {
+        roots.extend(
+            std::env::split_paths(&path).filter(|root| !root.as_os_str().is_empty()),
+        );
+    }
+
+    if let Some(program_files) = env_dir("ProgramFiles") {
+        roots.push(program_files.join("GitHub CLI"));
+    }
+    if let Some(local_app_data) = env_dir("LOCALAPPDATA") {
+        roots.push(local_app_data.join("Programs").join("GitHub CLI"));
+    }
+    if let Some(user_profile) = env_dir("USERPROFILE") {
+        roots.push(user_profile.join("scoop").join("shims"));
+    }
+    roots
+}
+
+fn env_dir(name: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
+    let value = std::env::var(name).ok()?;
+    if value.trim().is_empty() {
+        None
+    } else {
+        Some(PathBuf::from(value))
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    #![cfg(windows)]
+
+    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
+    use std::sync::{Mutex, MutexGuard};
+
+    use super::*;
+
+    const FAKE_GH: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../tests/fixtures/fake-gh.cmd");
+    static ENV_LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());
+    static NEXT_DIR: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
+
+    struct TestDir(PathBuf);
+
+    impl TestDir {
+        fn new(name: &str) -> Self {
+            let id = NEXT_DIR.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
+            let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
+                "sincearc-gh-test-{}-{}-{}",
+                std::process::id(),
+                name,
+                id
+            ));
+            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path);
+            std::fs::create_dir_all(&path).unwrap();
+            Self(path)
+        }
+
+        fn join(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> PathBuf {
+            self.0.join(path)
+        }
+    }
+
+    impl Drop for TestDir {
+        fn drop(&mut self) {
+            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn lock_env() -> MutexGuard<'static, ()> {
+        ENV_LOCK
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner())
+    }
+
+    fn set_mode(mode: &str) {
+        std::env::set_var("FAKE_GH_MODE", mode);
+    }
+
+    fn write_stub(dir: &Path, name: &str) {
+        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
+        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(FAKE_GH.len() + FAKE_GH.len() / 16);
+        for &byte in FAKE_GH {
+            if byte == b'\n' && bytes.last() != Some(&b'\r') {
+                bytes.push(b'\r');
+            }
+            bytes.push(byte);
+        }
+        std::fs::write(dir.join(name), bytes).unwrap();
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn probe_finds_nothing_reports_not_installed() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("ok");
+        let temp = TestDir::new("not-installed");
+        let empty = temp.join("empty");
+        std::fs::create_dir_all(&empty).unwrap();
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![empty], "fake-gh.cmd");
+
+        let error = gh.status().await.unwrap_err();
+        assert_eq!(error, GhError::NotInstalled);
+        assert_eq!(error.code(), 50710);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn probe_finds_stub_in_fixed_path_parses_version() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("ok");
+        let temp = TestDir::new("fixed-path");
+        let path_root = temp.join("path-root");
+        let fixed_root = temp.join("program-files").join("GitHub CLI");
+        std::fs::create_dir_all(&path_root).unwrap();
+        write_stub(&fixed_root, "fake-gh.cmd");
+        let expected_path = fixed_root.join("fake-gh.cmd");
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![path_root, fixed_root], "fake-gh.cmd");
+
+        let status = gh.status().await.unwrap();
+        assert!(status.available);
+        assert_eq!(status.version.as_deref(), Some("2.99.1"));
+        assert!(status.logged_in);
+        assert_eq!(status.gh_path, Some(expected_path.display().to_string()));
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn auth_status_nonzero_means_not_logged_in() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("not-logged-in");
+        let temp = TestDir::new("not-logged-in");
+        let root = temp.join("bin");
+        write_stub(&root, "fake-gh.cmd");
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![root], "fake-gh.cmd");
+
+        let status = gh.status().await.unwrap();
+        assert!(status.available);
+        assert_eq!(status.version.as_deref(), Some("2.99.1"));
+        assert!(!status.logged_in);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn garbage_version_output_is_unavailable() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("garbage-version");
+        let temp = TestDir::new("garbage-version");
+        let root = temp.join("bin");
+        write_stub(&root, "fake-gh.cmd");
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![root], "fake-gh.cmd");
+
+        let status = gh.status().await.unwrap();
+        assert!(!status.available);
+        assert!(status.version.is_none());
+        assert!(!status.logged_in);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn slow_stub_times_out_without_leaking_child() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("slow");
+        let temp = TestDir::new("slow");
+        let root = temp.join("bin");
+        write_stub(&root, "fake-gh.cmd");
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![root], "fake-gh.cmd");
+
+        let error = gh.status().await.unwrap_err();
+        assert_eq!(error, GhError::Timeout);
+        assert_eq!(error.code(), 50714);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
+    async fn present_but_unusable_exe_is_unavailable_not_a_crash() {
+        let _lock = lock_env();
+        set_mode("ok");
+        // 不用「垃圾 .exe」造这个场景：Windows 上 CreateProcess 撞上非 PE 文件会卡在系统错误弹窗
+        // （实测 300s 不返回），那测的是操作系统的 UX，不是我们的代码 —— 而且能把整条门禁挂住。
+        // 改成拿一个真实存在、但把 `--version` 当非法参数的可执行文件冒充 gh：退出码非 0
+        // ⇒ 判 available=false，且绝不 panic、不阻塞。
+        let me = std::env::current_exe().expect("current_exe");
+        let dir = me.parent().expect("parent").to_path_buf();
+        let name = me.file_name().expect("file_name").to_os_string();
+        let gh = RealGh::with_roots_and_exe(vec![dir], name);
+
+        let status = gh.status().await.expect("不该报错，只是不可用");
+        assert!(!status.available);
+        assert!(status.version.is_none());
+        assert!(!status.logged_in);
+    }
+}

+//! gh 命令层：DTO 映射与错误码/文案映射。
+
+pub mod cli;
+pub mod model;
+pub mod service;
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::sync::Arc;
+
+use serde::Serialize;
+use tauri::State;
+
+use crate::commands::CmdError;
+
+use self::model::{GhCli, GhError, GhStatus};
+use self::service::GhService;
+
+pub struct GhState(pub GhService);
+
+impl GhState {
+    pub fn new(cli: Arc<dyn GhCli>) -> Self {
+        Self(GhService::new(cli))
+    }
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, ts_rs::TS)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+#[ts(export, export_to = "../../src/lib/ipc/types.gen/")]
+pub struct GhStatusDto {
+    pub available: bool,
+    pub version: Option<String>,
+    pub logged_in: bool,
+    pub gh_path: Option<String>,
+}
+
+impl From<GhStatus> for GhStatusDto {
+    fn from(status: GhStatus) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            available: status.available,
+            version: status.version,
+            logged_in: status.logged_in,
+            gh_path: status.gh_path,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[tauri::command]
+pub async fn gh_status(
+    state: State<'_, GhState>,
+    force: Option<bool>,
+) -> Result<GhStatusDto, CmdError> {
+    match state.0.status(force.unwrap_or(false)).await {
+        Ok(status) => Ok(GhStatusDto::from(status)),
+        Err(error) => {
+            tracing::warn!(
+                target: "sincearc::gh",
+                code = error.code(),
+                error = ?error,
+                "gh status check failed"
+            );
+            Err(to_cmd_error(error))
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn to_cmd_error(error: GhError) -> CmdError {
+    let code = u32::from(error.code());
+    match error {
+        GhError::NotInstalled => {
+            CmdError::keyed(code, "err.gh.notInstalled", "没找到 GitHub CLI（gh）")
+        }
+        GhError::NotLoggedIn => {
+            CmdError::keyed(code, "err.gh.notLoggedIn", "gh 还没登录 GitHub")
+        }
+        GhError::Timeout => failed(code, "超时（2s/5s）"),
+        GhError::CliFailed { stderr } => failed(code, first_line(&stderr)),
+        GhError::RateLimited { reset } => failed(code, format!("限流，reset {reset}")),
+        GhError::RepoUnavailable => failed(code, "仓库不存在或没有权限"),
+        GhError::ParseFailed { version } => failed(code, format!("解析失败（gh {version}）")),
+    }
+}
+
+fn failed(code: u32, detail: impl Into<String>) -> CmdError {
+    let detail = detail.into();
+    let detail = if detail.trim().is_empty() {
+        "未知错误".to_string()
+    } else {
+        detail
+    };
+    CmdError::keyed_with(
+        code,
+        "err.gh.failed",
+        format!("gh 执行失败：{detail}"),
+        BTreeMap::from([("detail".to_string(), detail)]),
+    )
+}
+
+fn first_line(value: &str) -> String {
+    value.lines().next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_string()
+}

+//! gh 领域模型：与命令行参数、进程和 DTO 解耦。
+
+use async_trait::async_trait;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct GhStatus {
+    pub available: bool,
+    pub version: Option<String>,
+    pub logged_in: bool,
+    pub gh_path: Option<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum GhError {
+    NotInstalled,
+    NotLoggedIn,
+    RateLimited { reset: String },
+    RepoUnavailable,
+    Timeout,
+    CliFailed { stderr: String },
+    ParseFailed { version: String },
+}
+
+impl GhError {
+    pub fn code(&self) -> u16 {
+        match self {
+            Self::NotInstalled => 50710,
+            Self::NotLoggedIn => 50711,
+            Self::RateLimited { .. } => 50712,
+            Self::RepoUnavailable => 50713,
+            Self::Timeout | Self::CliFailed { .. } => 50714,
+            Self::ParseFailed { .. } => 50715,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[async_trait]
+pub trait GhCli: Send + Sync {
+    async fn status(&self) -> Result<GhStatus, GhError>;
+}

+//! gh 状态缓存：30 秒 TTL；错误不进入缓存。
+
+use std::sync::Arc;
+use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
+
+use tokio::sync::Mutex;
+
+use super::model::{GhCli, GhError, GhStatus};
+
+const STATUS_TTL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
+
+pub struct GhService {
+    cli: Arc<dyn GhCli>,
+    cache: Mutex<Option<(Instant, GhStatus)>>,
+}
+
+impl GhService {
+    pub fn new(cli: Arc<dyn GhCli>) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            cli,
+            cache: Mutex::new(None),
+        }
+    }
+
+    pub async fn status(&self, force: bool) -> Result<GhStatus, GhError> {
+        let mut cache = self.cache.lock().await;
+        if !force {
+            if let Some((at, status)) = cache.as_ref() {
+                if at.elapsed() < STATUS_TTL {
+                    return Ok(status.clone());
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        match self.cli.status().await {
+            Ok(status) => {
+                *cache = Some((Instant::now(), status.clone()));
+                Ok(status)
+            }
+            Err(error) => {
+                *cache = None;
+                Err(error)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use std::collections::VecDeque;
+    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
+    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
+
+    use async_trait::async_trait;
+
+    use super::*;
+
+    struct FakeGh {
+        calls: AtomicUsize,
+        results: Mutex<VecDeque<Result<GhStatus, GhError>>>,
+    }
+
+    impl FakeGh {
+        fn new(results: Vec<Result<GhStatus, GhError>>) -> Arc<Self> {
+            Arc::new(Self {
+                calls: AtomicUsize::new(0),
+                results: Mutex::new(results.into()),
+            })
+        }
+
+        fn calls(&self) -> usize {
+            self.calls.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[async_trait]
+    impl GhCli for FakeGh {
+        async fn status(&self) -> Result<GhStatus, GhError> {
+            self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
+            let mut results = self.results.lock().unwrap();
+            if results.len() > 1 {
+                results.pop_front().unwrap()
+            } else {
+                results.front().cloned().unwrap()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn sample_status(version: &str) -> GhStatus {
+        GhStatus {
+            available: true,
+            version: Some(version.to_string()),
+            logged_in: true,
+            gh_path: Some(format!(r"C:\fake\gh-{version}.exe")),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn service(results: Vec<Result<GhStatus, GhError>>) -> (Arc<FakeGh>, GhService) {
+        let fake = FakeGh::new(results);
+        let service = GhService::new(fake.clone());
+        (fake, service)
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test]
+    async fn cache_hits_within_ttl() {
+        let expected = sample_status("2.99.1");
+        let (fake, service) = service(vec![Ok(expected.clone())]);
+
+        assert_eq!(service.status(false).await.unwrap(), expected);
+        assert_eq!(service.status(false).await.unwrap(), expected);
+        assert_eq!(fake.calls(), 1);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test]
+    async fn force_bypasses_cache() {
+        let first = sample_status("2.99.1");
+        let second = sample_status("2.99.2");
+        let (fake, service) = service(vec![Ok(first), Ok(second.clone())]);
+
+        assert_eq!(
+            service.status(false).await.unwrap().version.as_deref(),
+            Some("2.99.1")
+        );
+        assert_eq!(service.status(true).await.unwrap(), second);
+        assert_eq!(fake.calls(), 2);
+    }
+
+    #[tokio::test]
+    async fn error_is_not_cached() {
+        let expected = sample_status("2.99.1");
+        let (fake, service) = service(vec![Err(GhError::Timeout), Ok(expected.clone())]);
+
+        assert!(service.status(false).await.is_err());
+        assert_eq!(service.status(false).await.unwrap(), expected);
+        assert_eq!(fake.calls(), 2);
+    }
+}

+@echo off
+rem 假 gh：按 argv 与 FAKE_GH_MODE 模拟 GitHub CLI 的各种形态。
+rem
+rem 为什么用 goto/label 而不是 if ( ... ) 块：批处理里括号块会被 echo 文本中的
+rem ")" 提前闭合（例如 "gh version 2.99.1 (2026-10-28)" 里的右括号），
+rem 结果整段条件被执行成无条件语句 —— 实测表现是 auth status 也返回 0 并打印版本行。
+rem 标签结构没有这个解析陷阱，代价只是多几行。
+setlocal
+
+if "%FAKE_GH_MODE%"=="slow" goto slow
+if "%1"=="--version" goto version
+if "%1"=="auth" if "%2"=="status" goto auth
+if "%1"=="crash" goto crash
+goto unsupported
+
+:slow
+ping -n 6 127.0.0.1 >nul
+
+:version
+if "%FAKE_GH_MODE%"=="garbage-version" goto garbage_version
+echo gh version 2.99.1 (2026-10-28)
+echo https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.99.1
+exit /b 0
+
+:garbage_version
+echo this is not a gh version
+exit /b 0
+
+:auth
+if "%FAKE_GH_MODE%"=="not-logged-in" goto not_logged_in
+echo github.com
+echo   Logged in to github.com account tester
+exit /b 0
+
+:not_logged_in
+>&2 echo You are not logged into any GitHub hosts.
+exit /b 1
+
+:crash
+>&2 echo fake gh crashed
+exit /b 1
+
+:unsupported
+>&2 echo unsupported fake gh command
+exit /b 1
